程序包 io.papermc.paper.event.player

类 PrePlayerAttackEntityEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
io.papermc.paper.event.player.PrePlayerAttackEntityEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class PrePlayerAttackEntityEvent extends PlayerEvent implements Cancellable
Called when the player tries to attack an entity. 当玩家试图攻击一个实体时调用。 This occurs before any of the damage logic, so cancelling this event will prevent any sort of sounds from being played when attacking. 这发生在任何伤害逻辑之前，因此取消此事件将阻止攻击时播放任何声音。 This event will fire as cancelled for certain entities, with willAttack() being false to indicate that this entity will not actually be attacked. 对于某些实体，此事件会以已取消的状态触发，且 willAttack() 为 false，表示该实体实际上不会被攻击。

Note: there may be other factors (invulnerability, etc) that will prevent this entity from being attacked that this event will not cover 注意：可能存在此事件未涵盖的其他因素（如无敌状态等）会阻止该实体被攻击

    • willAttack

      public boolean willAttack()
      Gets if this entity will be attacked normally. 获取该实体是否会被正常攻击。 Entities like falling sand will return false because their entity type does not allow them to be attacked. 像下落中的沙子这类实体将返回 false，因为其实体类型不允许被攻击。

      Note: there may be other factors (invulnerability, etc) that will prevent this entity from being attacked that this event will not cover 注意：可能存在此事件未涵盖的其他因素（如无敌状态等）会阻止该实体被攻击

      返回:
      if the entity will actually be attacked 该实体是否真的会被攻击

    • isCancelled

      public boolean isCancelled()
      从接口复制的说明: Cancellable
      Gets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins 获取此事件的取消状态。已取消的事件不会在服务器中执行，但仍会传递给其他插件
      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      true if this event is cancelled 此事件已取消则为 true

    • setCancelled

      public void setCancelled(boolean cancel)
      Sets if this attack should be cancelled, note if willAttack() returns false this event will always be cancelled. 设置此次攻击是否应被取消；注意若 willAttack() 返回 false，此事件将始终为已取消。
      指定者:
      setCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
